_about: AI-assisted: researched and assembled with ChatGPT (OpenAI). See docs/AI_USAGE.md. Snapshot compiled 2026-09-26 from Nigerian NDLEA case releases. These are separate legal outcome cohorts and named networks, not one unified organization. Court convictions, arrest allegations, report dates and exact judgment dates are distinguished. Each Nigeria marker is sourced to person-specific historical drug conduct; it is not a present position. No precise location, operational route, enforcement gap, or unlicensed photo is included. The Q1 release’s 130-year nominal total for Adegbite is concurrent, not a 130-year consecutive term. Two named Q1 defendants (Idris Yusuf and Ridwan Animashaun) were excluded for lack of person-specific historical Nigeria-operation evidence rather than mapped from court venue alone.
